findings.description: From ~00:08.5 to 00:09.0 the foreground hand holds a pinch grip at the jaw with no razor visible anywhere in or protruding from the fingers, while the mirror reflection at the same instants clearly shows the white razor blade against the cheek. At 00:08.25 and again at 00:09.25 the razor is visible in the real hand. The object vanishes and reappears with no put-down or pick-up action, and the reflection contradicts its absence.

From ~00:02.25 to 00:04.0 the reflected hand holds a bright white blade flat across the center of the forehead/brow, while the real hand holds a darker, comb-like elongated object angled into the hair at the temple. The same object appears with a different look and a different position and orientation on the two sides of the mirror.
